data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to display customizable badges on any widget.
data.what_it_does: It provides a Badge widget that can overlay a number, icon, or custom content on another widget. The badge’s position, shape, color, animation and tap behavior are fully configurable. It works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: Highlighting new or important UI elements
Indicating status or selection with a small overlay
avoid_when: You need system‑level app icon badges
You already use Flutter's built‑in Badge and don’t need extra features
Project constraints prevent adding material_ui or raising the SDK
strengths: Works across Android, iOS, web, desktop
Resolves naming conflict with Material’s Badge
weaknesses: Requires material_ui and a higher minimum SDK
Adds extra dependency and bundle size
Only a UI overlay, not a system badge
data.setup_notes: Add badges ^4.0.0 to pubspec, import with a namespace or hide Material's Badge, ensure material_ui is available (minimum Dart 3.13, Flutter 3.47).

alternatives.name: home_widget
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides app‑icon badge support and other home‑screen widgets, useful when you need system‑level badges instead of in‑app UI overlays.
